entries.reason: Known policy weights and replay observations are stored directly in typed Protobuf without a Value tree.
entries.schema: PolicyDocument and TraceDocument declare all persisted fields, including nested observations and steps.
entries.version: Typed wire and ProtoJSON write version 2; the version-1 script Value codec remains a compatibility boundary.
entries.migration: Version-1 script Value documents remain importable by the existing codec; unknown typed wire versions are refused until an explicit migration exists.
entries.unknown_fields: Binary imports reject unknown Protobuf fields recursively; ProtoJSON rejects unknown names.
entries.restore_atomicity: Decoders validate complete owning Policy or Trace values before returning them and never mutate an environment.

entries.reason: Typed persistence is the canonical policy and trace storage face; Value remains the script projection.

trim.absent_profile: No L1-L4 trim claim is made for this persistence format change.

entries.thread_affinity: Serialization borrows owning values synchronously; parsing has no shared state or callbacks.
cost_notes: Every persistence call is linear in weight or replay length and belongs at save/load boundaries.
